caseName: Sandles v. U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit
caseNameFull: John Eric SANDLES v. UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR the SEVENTH CIRCUIT.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
